source: The inputs and output already containZXMATH0000XZ elements. A materializing dense attention implementation additionally createsZXMATH0001XZ ZXMATH0002XZ score/probability state. ZXNAME0000XZ avoids storing those full matrices and retains only tiled working state plus row-wise statistics. As a result, the extra memory associated with the attention operation scales linearly with sequence length rather than quadratically.[4, 5]
zh: 输入和输出已包含ZXMATH0000XZ 元素。具体化的密集注意力实现还创建了 ZXMATH0001XZ ZXMATH0002XZ 分数/概率状态。 ZXNAME0000XZ 避免存储这些完整矩阵，并仅保留平铺工作状态以及按行统计信息。因此，与注意力操作相关的额外内存随序列长度线性扩展，而不是二次扩展。 [4, 5]
